geometry_intent.choice: the pocket allows a real outer drop; the inner direction reverses left across a gap, then right over a lower gap

play_contract.alternative: Ordinary held jumps remain legal; the actual rooted fruits also remain available to normal player input. This candidate declares no unconsumed hook choreography.
play_contract.counterexample: Try an immediate entry fall, a first-branch fall, direct pocket drop, no-H inward jump and a missed final jump; an early outer-bark approach is legal and must not receive a free cache.
play_contract.decision: Drop directly through the pocket for easier onward travel, or reverse left into the hollow and then right across the lower gap.
play_contract.failure: The final gap has a visible lower root and an explicit lower world escape. Recovery is incomplete until that actual port joins the world.
play_contract.new_behavior: The second direction reversal follows real stable reception; the Z is a route through open root bodies, not a command sequence password.
play_contract.observe: The thin eastern branch is a safe read point: the outer descent, inward fruit, left hollow and next lower root can be compared.
play_contract.reward: The left cache requires an additional outward-and-back thorn crossing. The world must execute a real richer OR reward; the factory awards nothing.
play_contract.world_requirement: Connect entry to its actual neighbour; after every local arrival at crown, execute crown_onward through the real eastern root window before the world continuation from onward. Connect failure_out to a real lower loop or separately verified recovery. Neither a full platform rectangle nor a local catch proves those world connections.

variant_contract.change: lower first bough and shallower inner fold
